recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the FHIR-11259 clarification in current build-scope source without changing later versioned-update policy decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-11259 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU2 overview wording that said meta.versionId changes whenever resource contents change. The resolution said that statement is true for servers indicating versioned or versioned-update support, otherwise there does not need to be a meta.versionId, and asked overview-dev/http text to be consistent with the three versioning support levels.
initial_application: The historical #11259 implementation commit 02305b03c50a337f8643c05fbcd26b0cd8235c78 added a Managing Versions section to source/overview-dev.html and the three support levels to source/http.html. Current source still retained the uncaveated overview meta.versionId note and later preserved meta.version wording in the HTTP bullets.
additional_context: Current http.html already says no-version servers must not return Resource.meta.versionId, and CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.versioning defines non-no-version values in terms of correctly tracking/populating the versionId meta-property. FHIR-34193 later clarified only the versioned-update wording and is already represented on the combined branch, so it was cited as related context rather than re-decided.
reconciliation: Published a source-changing commit on the combined branch. The commit updates source/http.html and source/overview-dev.html to use meta.versionId in the three-level support text, caveats the overview implementer note to apply when versioning is supported, and adds the same 'When present' caveat to the active Resource metadata notes.
source_changes: source/http.html: changed the no-version/versioned/versioned-update bullets from meta.version to meta.versionId.
source/overview-dev.html: changed the no-version bullet from .meta.version to meta.versionId and caveated the meta.versionId implementer note for systems that support versioning.
source/resource/resource-notes.xml: changed Resource metadata versionId usage text to 'When present' so the active Resource page matches optional/no-version behavior.

related_jiras.note: Later Published clarification of the versioned-update bullet in the same HTTP list; already represented on the combined branch and not re-decided.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue requiring meta.versionId wording to account for servers that do not support versioning and to align overview/http versioning support text.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes final WG intent and the exact semantic caveat required for current source.

evidence_items.summary: Historical #11259 commit added versioning support text to http.html and overview-dev.html.
evidence_items.learned: The issue was partially applied, but the current overview note and element-name wording still needed reconciliation.

evidence_items.summary: Current overview and HTTP narrative described versioning levels, but the bullets named meta.version and the overview example said meta.versionId changes on every content change.
evidence_items.learned: These active narrative pages still carried the misleading wording FHIR-11259 asked to clarify.

evidence_items.summary: The active Resource metadata notes described versionId as changing whenever content changes while also allowing servers to remove it when versions are unsupported.
evidence_items.learned: The same current-build metadata surface needed a narrow 'when present' caveat to remain consistent with the resolution.

evidence_items.summary: Later discussion led to FHIR-34193's change to the versioned-update wording, not to the no-version/meta.versionId caveat.
evidence_items.learned: This constrains the edit to the element name and FHIR-11259 caveat while leaving FHIR-34193's later decision intact.
